[[File:Ray Bordier DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Ray Bordier at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Ray Bordier''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 91 from Philadelphia, PA.<ref name="sm-fan" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Bordier finished 12th in the [[Young Jedi]] Qualifier.<ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref> From 2007 to 2012 he played [[Players Committee]] events in the Northeast, including the [[2007 New York State Championship|2007 New York]], [[2007 New Jersey State Championship|New Jersey]] and [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship|Pennsylvania]] State Championships and the Match Play Championships of 2007, 2008 and 2010–2012; from 2009 his deck sheets give the username Spectre.<ref name="mpc07d1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/MPC/2007+MPC+D1.pdf 2007 MPC D1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org (sheet signed "Ray Bordier").</ref><ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2012/2012mpcday1.pdf 2012 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> Those decks were first published on this wiki under the name '''Roy Bordier''', a misreading of the handwritten sheets.

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Ray Bordier (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 6]], dated 2009 on this wiki. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: New York States 2007 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Ray Bordier|Card Credits]].
